arguments.summary: A Cobalt Strike beacon was delivered to host WS-FIN-042 via a phishing email opened by user jsmith. The malware executed through an encoded PowerShell command launched from Outlook, loaded an unsigned DLL via rundll32, and established a C2 channel to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS. Post-compromise activities included lateral movement attempts, host file modification, and scheduled task creation for persistence. The incident was contained through firewall blocking, credential reset, endpoint scanning, and automated hardening.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_DNS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike Beacon using dynamic DNS domains"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2"
    strings:
        $dns_fallback = "c2.update-service.xyz" wide ascii
        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{b1e5}" wide ascii
        $c2_ip = "198.51.100.23" wide ascii
        $encoded_b64 = { 49 00 45 00 41 } // 'IEA' base64 prefix common in encoded PS
    condition:
        any of them
}
